sentences: I check the tire pressure with a gauge before every ride to ensure the tires are inflated to the recommended level.
I adjust the seat post height so my leg is almost fully extended at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
I apply lubricant to the chain and wipe off the excess with a rag to keep the drivetrain running smoothly.
I remove the rear wheel, replace the inner tube, and reinstall the wheel after fixing a flat tire.
I ride my bicycle to the grocery store, lock it to a rack, and carry the bags home in a backpack.
I park my bike in the garage and hang it on a wall hook to save floor space.
I thread the cable lock through the frame and both wheels before attaching it to a sturdy post.
I shift to a lower gear when approaching a hill and then shift to a higher gear on the descent.
I squeeze both brake levers evenly to slow down and come to a complete stop at intersections.
I wash the bicycle frame with soapy water and a soft brush to remove dirt and grime.
I replace the brake pads when they wear down to the metal backing indicator line.
I use a spoke wrench to true the wheel by adjusting the tension of individual spokes.
I install a rear rack on my bicycle to carry panniers for commuting and touring.
I check each spoke for proper tension by plucking it and listening for a consistent tone.
I fold the hinge on my folding bicycle and carry it onto the train during rush hour.
I charge the electric bicycle battery overnight and check the charge level before leaving.
I mount a cycling computer on the handlebars to track my speed, distance, and cadence.
I attach a front white light and a rear red reflector to be visible in low light.
I adjust the derailleur's high and low limit screws to prevent the chain from falling off.
I remove the pedals with a pedal wrench and apply grease to the threads before reinstalling them.
